_comment: scripts/i18n-lint.allow.json — allow-list for scripts/check-i18n.mjs (SPEC-v0.8 §3-3). Each entry MUST carry a non-empty reason explaining why the finding is accepted rather than converted to t(). Keys are `<file>:<line>:<kind>` — see check-i18n-lib.mjs's buildFindingKey. Only ever add an entry after triaging a real finding that genuinely should stay a literal (e.g. a debug-only console message, a non-visible internal identifier the detector's heuristics mis-flagged), not speculatively.

entries.reason: The "cloud-pulse" wordmark is the product name, kept in every language per CODING_CONVENTIONS.md/DECISIONS_LOG.md (product names/API terms stay in English).
